notes: All 12 views inspected. Sword-in-the-stone set piece: an octagonal stepped plinth with glowing rune inlays, moss and crystal shards, and a pale blade sunk into the top with a brass crossguard, a blue cord grip and a gold pommel. Two glowing rings and sparkle cards orbit the blade. Unlike the rejected display-stand weapons, the GLB exposes a SEPARATE `enchanted-sword_weapon` node alongside the plinth body and three glow nodes, so the sword can be lifted out and used as a handheld weapon or the whole thing used as a set piece. That separability is why this passes where the cutlass, machete and pike did not.
limitations: Stylised Cozy-kit palette rather than photoreal materials.
The glow rings and sparkles are emissive geometry, not particles; they will not animate without a rig.
The plinth and sword are separate nodes but each is internally fused.
method: Visual inspection of local-model renders and technical reports
